charter.authority: §6 case architecture; §5 safety invariants. No case family was added and no scientific semantics beyond DRAFT-004 were introduced.

fixtures.expected_property: The bridge constructs the declared complete WEXP input without inventing missing source facts. A positive control that cannot be constructed is a finding about the bridge, not about either party.
fixtures.provenance: Byte-identical reuse of the published INTEROP-001 P fixture, WEXP-dev/wexp-interop source/pair-freeze/fixtures/WE-EP-P.json. Charter §6 says the positive control SHOULD reuse it; no source-identity problem blocks exact binding, so it is reused exactly rather than re-authored.

fixtures.expected_property: Fail closed or remain explicitly underdetermined. The independent meter's observation carries no action_caid, so the relation binding that observation to the selected action instance is absent and must not be supplied by inference.
fixtures.provenance: Byte-identical reuse of the published INTEROP-001 P-1 missing-action_caid regression, WEXP-dev/wexp-interop source/pair-freeze/fixtures/WE-EP-P-1.json. Charter §6 requires this family to include it or a byte-identical reuse of it.

fixtures.expected_property: Fail closed. The appraisal is made about action instance operation:plant-7:002 while the signed observations attest operation:plant-7:001. Evidence for one action instance must not be usable as evidence for another, and equality of action type is insufficient.
fixtures.provenance: Derived from C-00 by one declared mutation class, rebind_evaluated_action_instance, touching only options.expectedActionHash, options.expectedActionCaid and options.expectedOperationId. Observation bytes and Ed25519 signatures are byte-identical to C-00, so the fixture fails on causal provenance rather than on cryptography — a signature break would mask the property under test.

fixtures.expected_property: Fail closed or remain explicitly underdetermined. The observations are causally bound to the selected action instance and validly signed, and are still inadmissible: they fall outside the relying party's declared observation windows. Causal relation does not confer admissibility.
fixtures.provenance: Derived from C-00 by one declared mutation class, shift_evaluation_context_window, touching only observationWindows[*].not_before, observationWindows[*].not_after and options.now. Observation bytes and signatures are byte-identical to C-00. This is what isolates I-03b from I-03a: nothing about causal provenance changed.

fixtures.expected_property: Fail closed, preserving the phase boundary and the precommitted claim ceiling. Accepted controller status is authorization-phase evidence; it must not be promoted into a delivered-effect or execution claim.
fixtures.provenance: Derived from C-00 by one declared mutation class, remove_higher_phase_observation: the independent meter's delivered_mw observation is removed. Removal only. The surviving executor observation is byte-identical to C-00 observations[0] and remains validly signed, and predicted_effects and sourceRequirements still demand an independent_observer. No evidence was invented to fill the gap, as §6 requires.

fixtures.family: H-03 claim expansion and authority conversion
fixtures.expected_property: Fail closed, or carry both attempts through as explicitly unsupported. Completion and independent verification are not supported by the evidence and must not be silently added. Every authority-conversion request must be refused: an EP receipt, outcome observation or mapped appraisal must not become reusable permission, local authorization, Gate admission, delegated authority, or approval for a future action, and missing authority must not be inferred from successful appraisal.
fixtures.provenance: Derived from C-00 by one declared mutation class, attach_unsupported_claim_and_authority_conversion. emilia_input is byte-identical to C-00 — no evidence added, altered or removed. What is attached is an attempted claim and five attempted authority conversions, which is precisely what this family exists to test.

verification.declared_mutation_matches_actual_delta: verified for every derivative; no undeclared change outside seed provenance fields

non_claims: Binding these fixtures is not a Design Freeze and confers no execution or publication authority.
